dataset_name: Hinglish ABSA Benchmark Dataset (Pilot Research Subset)
source_identifier: Curated Multi-Domain Code-Mixed E-Commerce Pilot Reviews
source_verification_status: UNVERIFIED (Constructed/curated pilot dataset, not a verified real-world platform crawl)
nature_of_data: Manually constructed / Semi-synthetic illustrative pilot records
description: Curated Hinglish customer reviews across 9 product categories (Smartphones, Audio, Laptops, Footwear, Clothing, etc.). Explicitly annotated with aspect spans, opinion spans, polarities, span languages, and derived pair types.
study_readiness_notes: Suitable for preliminary pilot evaluation and unit testing; insufficient sample size (N=61) for definitive statistical conclusions without wide confidence intervals.
data_collection_method: Expert curation and deterministic rule derivation
inter_annotator_agreement: UNVERIFIED (Single-expert curation with deterministic policy reconciliation)
annotation_protocol: Guidelines require exact span containment in review_text, span-level language tagging (English, Hindi, Mixed, Uncertain), and deterministic pair-type derivation with strict uncertainty quarantine.
